zh.title: 倫敦法院聽證會恐終結新創航空Global Airlines
zh.summary: 新創航空Global Airlines面臨倫敦聽證會考驗
body: 根據外媒 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 20 日的報導，試圖重新啟用空中巴士 A380 客機的新創航空公司 Global Airlines，目前正面臨一場於倫敦舉辦的法院聽證會。這場法律訴訟程序，極有可能在該公司正式起飛營運之前，就為其營運畫下句點。
在此同時，全球其他主要航空公司也在調整其空中巴士 A380 機隊的營運規劃。作為背景對照，澳洲航空已於 2026 年 8 月 26 日證實，將把空中巴士 A380 機隊的退役時間提前至 2028 年；而英國航空則計劃推出新的 14 小時空中巴士 A380 航線。

en.title: London Court Hearing Could End Airbus A380 Startup Global Airlines
en.summary: Global Airlines faces a critical London court hearing that could end its startup operations.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying on September 20, 2026, the startup airline Global Airlines is facing a London court hearing. This legal proceeding could potentially end the company's operations before they can officially take off.

Global Airlines has been attempting to revive the Airbus A380 superjumbo. This development occurs as other global carriers adjust their widebody operations. For context, Australian flag carrier Qantas announced on August 26, 2026, that it will bring forward the retirement of its Airbus A380 fleet to 2028. Additionally, British Airways was scheduled to launch a new 14-hour Airbus A380 route.
